title: Pappu Sharma v. U.P. Power Corporation Ltd.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: V.K. Shukla and Pratyush Kumar, JJ.
disposition: Writ dismissed; billing grievance relegated to Supply Code authority.
headnote: A writ whose pith and substance is a challenge to the validity and correctness of an electricity bill is not to be entertained; the consumer must approach the authority under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
facts: Pappu Sharma and another invoked the writ jurisdiction of the Allahabad High Court against U.P. Power Corporation Ltd. and two others, questioning an electricity bill raised against them. Counsel for the petitioners were Pravesh Kumar and Anil Kumar Shukla; the Corporation was represented by Baleshwar Chaturvedi. The Division Bench of V.K. Shukla and Pratyush Kumar JJ. heard the matter at Court No. 32 on 8 June 2015.

holding_units.holding: Where a writ petition in pith and substance questions the validity and correctness of an electricity bill, the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 furnishes the forum; the consumer must approach the authority concerned, and the High Court will not entertain the writ.
holding_units.flag: Court cited the Supply Code generally, without a clause number.

not_decided.point: validity and correctness of the electricity bill
not_decided.note: Writ not entertained on the merits; petitioners directed to the authority under the Supply Code.
